removed_curls.description: Small curl tucked behind the neck on the right

prompts:

DELETE these two complete small curls, including their cream fill and ink outlines:
1. The isolated C-shaped curl centered at x=42%, y=75.6% of the image. It floats in the lower-left gap just LEFT of the large central downward-curving foreground tentacle, immediately above the wave marks. Approximate region x=35–49%, y=68–83%. Remove the entire disconnected curl, leaving genuinely transparent negative space. Do not erase the adjacent large central tentacle.
2. The small tucked C-shaped curl centered at x=80.9%, y=49.2%. It sits behind the head/neck on the RIGHT, just LEFT of the large rightmost upper arm. Approximate region x=72–86%, y=45–55%. Remove that whole small curl and leave clean transparent negative space between the mantle/neck and the connected right-side arm. Do not remove the large rightmost arm or its hook tip.

Do not replace either curl with another appendage, connector, shadow, color patch, ink stroke or wave. Reconstruct a smooth surrounding outline only if the second curl touches an existing main contour. Everything outside these two local erasures should stay as close to pixel-identical as possible. Do not redesign, add detail, rotate, rescale, crop or change facial anatomy. Preserve genuine alpha transparency; no background or checkerboard.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the cleaned Kraken with both unwanted curls successfully removed.
Image 2 is a SUPPORTING REFERENCE for the wave marks ONLY: the previous version.

Keep the entire creature in Image 1 pixel-identical, including the clean transparent gaps at (42%,75.6%) and (80.9%,49.2%). Do NOT restore either deleted curl or add any arm. Keep the original canvas size, scale, left-facing pose, jagged mantle, crimson eyes, outlines, fills and genuine alpha transparency.

These are separate flat ink water marks underneath the lower tentacles, not cream-filled curls or anatomy. Use the same sparse low curves, line weight and bottom placement as Image 2. Add no other marks, no paper/background, no texture, no text. Do not redesign or redraw the creature.
invariants: Preserve left-facing pose, jagged mantle, crimson eyes, major connected arms, simple ink/cream/tan style, alpha transparency and waterline marks.
